label: Boudoir Solo Pose
description: The source's named solo pose catalogue, written as body mechanics a model could hold.

items.name: editorial
items.text: a studied editorial stance, weight stacked over the back hip, front knee softened, chin leveled toward the lens

items.name: relaxed-recline
items.text: lying flat on the back, knees softly bent and tipped together, one arm resting above the head

items.name: elegant-lay
items.text: side-lying with the head propped on one hand, top hip stacked high, waist dipped to deepen the curve

items.name: bold-stand
items.text: standing with full weight settled onto one straight leg, free knee bent, hip pushed to a strong angle

items.name: casual-lean
items.text: one shoulder pressed to the wall, ankles crossed, hips angled away from the lens

items.name: gentle-turn
items.text: back turned three-quarters to the camera, spine gently rotated to carry the chin over the raised shoulder

items.name: mirrored-beauty
items.text: seated facing the vanity mirror, torso to the glass, face returned toward the camera so both angles read

items.name: window-gaze
items.text: standing at the window, weight on the far leg, face lifted into the light falling through the glass

items.name: reclining-goddess
items.text: lying on the back, arms framed overhead, spine arched so the body draws one long S-curve

items.name: seated-twist
items.text: seated centered on the sofa, hips square while the upper torso twists toward the camera, leading shoulder dropped

items.name: reverse-chair
items.text: straddling a reversed chair, forearms stacked on the backrest, chin turned back over one shoulder

items.name: sofa-sidewall
items.text: kneeling on the sofa cushions, both palms braced against the wall, back arched away from it

items.name: graceful-arc
items.text: lying face down on the bed, chest propped on the forearms, knees bent so the crossed ankles rise into the air

items.name: elevated-legs
items.text: lying on the back on the floor, legs extended straight upward, toes pointed

items.name: sideways-silhouette
items.text: lying on one side, top knee crossed forward over the bottom leg, waistline dipped

items.name: sidelight-sit
items.text: perched on the table edge facing the window, legs long, ankles crossed, palms planted behind the hips

items.name: backward-glance-chair
items.text: seated on a chair, upper body leaned back over the backrest so the throat and jawline lift

items.name: staircase-repose
items.text: reclining across the staircase, body stepped along the treads, one arm trailing down a lower stair

items.name: sofa-stretch
items.text: seated sideways on the sofa, legs extended along the cushions, toes pointed, torso upright

items.name: reversed-elevation
items.text: lying across the bed on the back, head tipped just off the mattress edge so the hair falls free

items.name: bedside-knees
items.text: seated on the floor with the back against the bed, knees pulled to the chest, arms wrapped around the shins

items.name: self-embrace
items.text: lying on the back on the bed, arms crossed over the chest, hands resting on opposite shoulders

items.name: tiptoe-wall
items.text: hips leaned back against the wall, heels lifted onto tiptoe, calves engaged, one palm flat on the wall

items.name: dynamic-stretch
items.text: a standing full-body stretch, arms overhead and hips shifted sideways so the silhouette bows into a crescent

items.name: heel-strap-lean
items.text: seated on the bed edge, folded forward over one raised knee, fingers working the heel strap

items.name: casual-chair
items.text: seated on a chair with heels lifted onto the front rail, leaning forward, fingertips grazing the floor

items.name: kneeling-heels
items.text: kneeling upright on the bed, sitting back onto the heels, spine tall, palms resting on the thighs

items.name: floor-side-sit
items.text: seated on the floor with both legs folded to one side, weight taken on one straight arm

items.name: bed-edge-cross
items.text: sitting on the bed edge, legs crossed high at the knee, torso leaned back onto both palms

items.name: doorway-frame
items.text: standing in the doorway, arms raised to press against both sides of the frame
